_about.what: One run of fiam/book.py. The source of truth for every number.

sections.run: which code made it, and over which months
sections.performance: returns, risk, and the market regression
sections.costs: what trading and borrowing took out
sections.compliance: competition limits, measured after rounding to whole shares
sections.robustness: what happens if our assumptions are wrong
sections.notes: caveats that belong next to the numbers
sections.basis: IR and Sharpe on excess return. CAGR and drawdown on total return.

_about.rounding: 6 decimals, applied once on write. Maths runs at full precision.

notes.market_series: S&P 500 price index (FRED SP500), excludes dividends
notes.tradable_universe: screened on dated WRDS exits, final-month payouts booked
notes.status: research backtest; the same code and data give the same numbers anywhere
